title: Near-Doubles: One Less Than a Double
objective: Derive a fact one less than a known double (e.g. 6 + 5 = 6 + 6 - 1), completing the pair with 3.1.3 and forcing the plus/minus distinction.
studentQuestion: This time, is the answer more or less than the double?

teaching.setup: 6 + 5, presented immediately after a 6 + 7-style problem for contrast.
teaching.see: Is 5 one more than 6, or one less?
teaching.break: Rewrite 5 as 6 - 1 (recognizing 6+5 as double 6, minus one).
teaching.transform: 12 - 1 = 11 — same value as 6 + 5, reached via a known double.

examples.transfer: Given both 8 + 9 and 8 + 7 together, apply +1 to one and -1 to the other.

mastery.evidence: Correctly chooses +1 or -1 appropriately across 3 mixed near-double problems.
